verdict.rationale: Docusaurus explicitly builds MDX into static HTML files for serving (docusaurus-docs-2/17), with no documented feature to also serve raw markdown at a `.md` URL variant; probes confirm no llms.txt or docs.md endpoint exists even on Docusaurus's own site (docusaurus-probe-1, docusaurus-probe-2). No evidence of any markdown-at-URL or agent-friendly raw-content serving capability.
